snippet.title: METRO 2039 | Gameplay Trailer - Renegade (4K)
snippet.description:
Revealed at Gamescom Opening Night Live, our second gameplay trailer - Renegade, gives you a further glimpse into the protagonist, The Stranger.  

We are showing you more of our mechanics, weaponry and combat both below and above ground. 

Plus - we just revealed our Collector's Edition - register your interest now! https://deepsilver.com/games/metro2039/news/your-first-look-at-the-metro-2039-collector-s-edition

We know how important the series is to our community, and we’re committed to crafting the ultimate METRO experience - one that draws on the very best of the series’ history, while dramatically expanding its scope for atmosphere, immersion and powerful storytelling.

If you’re fortunate enough to be at Gamescom yourself this year, we’d love to see you at our booth in Hall 9.1! Stop by while you’re here at the show and you’ll have the chance to lose yourself in the first demo of a METRO experience you’ll never forget.

Wishlist METRO 2039  
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9nt5pb1rz9ld
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009337
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2590240/METRO_2039/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/metro-2039-086260

read more about the trailer at www.METRO2039.com

Deep in the Metro lies Sevastopolskaya Station, at once a shelter from the irradiated world above, while at the same time just another refuge trapped in the grip of the Fuhrer’s propaganda.

Tonight’s trailer provides your first look at this crucial location in METRO 2039. It’s from here that the Stranger will uncover vital information about the pursuit of his target, and where he’ll make his preparations for the journey ahead. Quite what, or who he is chasing down, you will have to wait to find out. Keep your radios tuned to the official METRO social media channels and newsletter for more updates, trailers and news. Follow us here on YouTube for the latest video content. 

#Metro2039 #4AGames #DeepSilver

About METRO 2039:  

The year is 2039.   

For a quarter century, the last survivors of nuclear war have been locked in bitter conflict deep in the Metro tunnels beneath the poisoned city of Moscow. Now, finally, they have been united by a single leader, a fanatical Spartan known as Hunter. 

But this is no peace: Hunter’s Novoreich regime rules through propaganda and fear, subjugating the population in the name of a new war for the surface against a dark and terrifying enemy. 

In the wilderness beyond the city, the reclusive Stranger is haunted by violent waking nightmares. When the ghosts of his past force him out of exile, he must undertake a harrowing journey into the shattered ruins of Moscow, to the one place he swore he’d never go. 

The Metro. 

Experience the most shocking METRO adventure yet in a powerful single-player story that weaves exploration, survival, combat and stealth across a hauntingly beautiful but deadly world with unparalleled immersion. 

Inspired by the worldwide best-selling METRO book trilogy by Dmitry Glukhovsky
